resources.description: Convert a raster image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP) into clean, editable, self-verified SVG vector art. Pay per conversion in USDC on Base via x402 - no API key, no subscription. Send JSON with imageBase64 or imageUrl; tune with mode (auto/binary/color/pixel), detail (high/normal/clean/poster), transparent or solid background, and outline flags. Returns the SVG plus a quality report (paths, similarity score).
